CookiesUtil.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes cookie state by storing the provided cookies file reference and resetting the loaded cookies to None." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> cookies_file </REF>: object "Reference to the file path or file object used for loading cookies; stored unchanged on the instance."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Store the input parameter cookies_file directly into the instance attribute self.cookies_file without transformation. RESULT self.cookies_file]
            [COMMAND Set the instance attribute self.cookies to the literal constant None, representing the default unloaded state. RESULT self.cookies]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
CookiesUtil.get_cookies:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Retrieves the 'cookies' value from the response mapping, assigns it to the instance attribute self.cookies, and then calls self._save_cookies() to persist the cookies." get_cookies]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> reponse </REF>: dict "A mapping-like object containing the key 'cookies' whose value is assigned to self.cookies."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign self.cookies to the value of reponse['cookies'], preserving the reference and any None or falsey value unchanged. RESULT self.cookies]
            [COMMAND Call self._save_cookies() without capturing its return value. RESULT _save_cookies_return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
CookiesUtil.load_cookies:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Loads JSON cookie data from the configured cookies file and returns it as a dictionary, returning an empty dictionary if the file is not found." load_cookies]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: dict "Parsed JSON cookies data as a dictionary, or an empty dictionary when the cookies file is not found."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Inside the try block, attempt to open the file specified by self.cookies_file in read mode. RESULT file]
            [COMMAND Inside the try block, parse the JSON content from the opened file into a dictionary. RESULT cookies_data]
            [COMMAND Inside the try block, return the parsed cookies_data dictionary. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: FileNotFoundError is raised while attempting to open the file specified by self.cookies_file.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return an empty dictionary as the fallback result. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
CookiesUtil._save_cookies:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Save the current cookies to the configured cookies file as JSON, returning True on success and False on any failure." _save_cookies]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> success </REF>: boolean "True if the cookies were saved successfully, False if any exception occurred during saving."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Open self.cookies_file in write mode and assign the opened file handle to file. RESULT file]
            [COMMAND Write self.cookies to the opened file as JSON using json.dump. RESULT dump_result]
            [COMMAND Return True after the JSON dump completes successfully. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Any exception occurs while opening self.cookies_file in write mode or while writing self.cookies as JSON.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False from the exception handler. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
CookiesUtil.set_cookies:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Builds a semicolon-separated cookie header string from all key-value pairs in self.cookies and assigns it to request['cookies']." set_cookies]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> request </REF>: dict "The request object or dictionary where the generated cookie header is written under the key 'cookies'."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Retrieve the key-value pairs from self.cookies using its items() method, preserving the mapping's insertion order. RESULT cookie_items]
            [COMMAND For each key and value in cookie_items, format the pair as a single string in the form key=value using the f-string f'{key}={value}', without escaping, quoting, or encoding the raw values. RESULT formatted_pairs]
            [COMMAND Join all elements of formatted_pairs into one string using the separator '; '; when formatted_pairs is empty, produce an empty string. RESULT cookie_header]
            [COMMAND Assign cookie_header to request['cookies'], overwriting any previous value at that key. RESULT request]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
